title: This Free Website Exposes Your Competitors…
description:
This free website exposes your competitors' best pages and shows you exactly how to steal their traffic.

Here's how to do it:

Google your service and city. See who ranks number one. That's your target.

Go to Ubersuggest.com. Type in their domain. Click "Top Pages by Traffic."

You'll see every blog post and page on their site that's pulling traffic, plus the exact keywords each one ranks for. This is their entire content strategy laid out for you.

Find a page that's working and look for gaps. Is it missing location keywords? Missing frequently asked questions? Missing real customer examples? Missing specific numbers?

Now write your own blog on the same topic and do it better. More detail. More proof. More local specificity. Real photos from actual jobs.

That's it. You don't have to guess what content to create. Your competitors already proved what works in your market. Take their winning topics and build better versions.

This is one of the easiest ways to start ranking for keywords that send real customers to your site. Most local businesses skip this and wonder why their content never ranks. The ones who actually do this quietly stack wins every month.

Want us to find your competitor's best pages and build better versions for you? Comment "SEO" and we got you.
